# Requirements

Make Cody's workspace feel as smooth as Codex / Claude Code / Cursor — but Matrix-fied — by closing three concrete gaps found in the live surface + engine during a real testing session (2026-07-03). (1) DEAD-SILENT WORK: codyd emits NOTHING between the /chat dispatch and the first milestone while it scans the workspace, authors the Stack Decision Record (N divergent candidates hot + cold adjudication), authors the plan, and authors the Design Language Record — each several LLM calls, minutes long (cody/internal/server/engine.go drive(): the first publish is plan.created ~L531) — and the Engineer/Architect viewport renders BLANK the whole time (apps/client/components/matrix/cody/cody-workspace.tsx RunView: the 'Cody is working' fallback only shows for non-board tiers), so for ~10 minutes the user cannot tell any work is happening and never gets an acknowledgment that their prompt even landed. (2) NO COMMUNICATION FLOW: the only user->Cody inputs are steer (running only) and answer (on a gate); the chat rail textarea is disabled-dead when not running and a stopped run is a UI dead-end despite the 'say continue' copy (cody-workspace.tsx ChatRail canSteer gate), and Cody narrates nothing between milestones. (3) NOTHING PERSISTS: chat.assistant and message.complete are excluded from the durable-trace whitelist (cody/internal/server/trace.go traceWorkspaceTypes) so the conversation is LOST on reopen, and History is per-browser localStorage (apps/client/lib/cody/recent-runs.ts) with no server list endpoint, so work history is neither durable nor cross-device. The fix is three coordinated pillars: an ALWAYS-LIVE progress spine fed by new engine phase/activity + heartbeat events (never a blank viewport, including the approve->next-phase gap that today shows nothing); SMOOTH two-way communication via ONE context-aware composer (start when idle, steer while running, answer on a gate, continue a stopped/finished run) plus Cody narrating as it goes; and TOTAL PERSISTENCE of the transcript (both sides) + server-side cross-device history. All under Matrix house rules: separation by background tone only (never border strokes), no emojis/purple gradients/glow, a single Paxeer Blue accent, result-over-protocol copy. This feature COMPLEMENTS spec/cody + spec/cody-client (it never re-opens their done tasks); Cody stays signing-keyless, MCL-free, and its durable-plan determinism is untouched because every new event is a pure publish/Observer side-channel.

## Requirement 1: Always-live progress — the run is never a blank viewport

**User Story:** As a user, I want to see that Cody heard me and is working from the very first second, so that I never sit for minutes wondering whether anything is happening.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a run is dispatched, THE surface SHALL immediately acknowledge it and render a persistent activity region that is NEVER blank while the run is running or awaiting input — including the silent understand -> stack-decision -> plan -> design-decision phases that today show nothing in Engineer/Architect.
2. THE activity region SHALL show the current phase in plain language, a liveness indicator, and elapsed time, and SHALL advance as the engine moves between phases.
3. THE activity region SHALL render in EVERY mode tier with register-appropriate copy (outcome language in Prototype, technical in Engineer/Architect) and SHALL honor the UI house rules (separation by background tone only, no borders/emojis/gradients/glow, single Paxeer Blue accent).
4. WHEN a decision (SDR/DLR) or a needs-input stall is resolved (approve / override / answer), THE surface SHALL immediately show a 'continuing' activity state until the next milestone and SHALL NOT revert to a blank viewport (the observed approve-then-nothing bug).

## Requirement 2: Engine phase/activity narration (so the spine has real data)

**User Story:** As the client, I want the engine to tell me what phase it is in and that it is still alive, so that the surface reflects genuine progress instead of guessing.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. codyd SHALL emit a lightweight activity event at each orchestration boundary in the run's lifecycle: run accepted/started, understanding the workspace, weighing stack options (SDR), authoring the plan, designing the interface (DLR), working on a task, verifying a task, and preparing a preview.
2. DURING long-running phases (SDR/plan/DLR generation and worker execution) codyd SHALL emit a periodic liveness heartbeat carrying the current phase and elapsed time, bounded and cancel-safe, so the client shows continuous progress rather than a frozen state.
3. ACTIVITY copy SHALL be result-oriented with no orchestrator/worker/sheet jargon on the user surface, and the register SHALL follow the run's mode.
4. ACTIVITY emission SHALL be a pure side-channel (broker publish / orchestrator Observer) that never alters the loop, the acceptance gate, or the determinism of the durable plan; Cody remains signing-keyless and MCL-free.

## Requirement 3: Smooth two-way communication — one context-aware composer

**User Story:** As a user, I want to talk to Cody naturally at any point — kick off, redirect, answer its question, or tell it to continue — so that working with it feels like a conversation, not a set of disabled boxes.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE surface SHALL present ONE always-available composer whose action is context-aware: start a run when idle, steer while running, answer when the run awaits input (free text or a decision verdict), and continue a stopped/completed run — and SHALL NEVER present a dead disabled 'Run is idle' box.
2. CONTINUE SHALL resume the same conversation and its durable plan (reusing the conversation id) at the correct next task, honestly reflecting that a re-dispatch resumes existing work rather than starting over.
3. CODY'S questions (needs-input, SDR, DLR, stop-and-ask) SHALL surface inline in the conversation transcript as first-class prompts the user answers in place — not only as a separate card.
4. THE composer and transcript SHALL follow the UI house rules and the active mode's register.

## Requirement 4: Total persistence — chats, transcript, and history survive everything

**User Story:** As a user, I want everything Cody and I said and did to still be there when I come back — on any device — so that no context is ever lost to a closed tab or a new browser.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE full conversation SHALL be durable: the user's turns (the initiating message, steers, answers) AND Cody's messages (chat.assistant) AND the milestone activity SHALL persist to the durable trace, closing the current gap where chat.assistant/message.complete are excluded (cody/internal/server/trace.go).
2. buildRunFromTrace SHALL rebuild the transcript and the last-known activity on reopen IDENTICALLY to the live fold (durable == live) across the new event types.
3. HISTORY SHALL be server-side and cross-device: codyd SHALL expose GET /conversations listing the user's runs (id, title, status, mode, project, updated_at) sourced from the durable ledgers, and the client History page SHALL read it; localStorage MAY remain a fast-path cache but SHALL NOT be the source of truth.
4. WORKSPACES (files) and the project registry remain durable on the volume as they are today; this requirement adds conversational + history durability on top without regressing them.

## Requirement 5: The smooth agent feel — Codex/Claude-Code/Cursor, Matrix-fied

**User Story:** As a user, I want the Cody workspace to feel like a best-in-class coding agent, so that it is a joy to use and unmistakably Matrix.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE workspace SHALL read like a modern coding-agent session: a running transcript of what Cody is doing (narrated steps), a clear working/liveness state, inline questions and answers, and a persistent history you can reopen — comparable in smoothness to Codex / Claude Code / Cursor.
2. THE experience SHALL be distinctly Matrix: a single Paxeer Blue accent, Inter + JetBrains Mono, separation by background-tone contrast only (no border strokes), no emojis/gradients/glow, and result-over-protocol copy.
3. TIERS SHALL differ ONLY in disclosure and register, never in the underlying run/transcript/activity data, consistent with spec/cody-client req 4.5.

## Requirement 6: Real verification — no fakes

**User Story:** As the owner, I want every smoothness pillar proven against real code paths, so that a green result reflects a genuinely smoother, durable Cody.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. REDUCER: buildRunFromTrace SHALL equal the live fold across the new event family (run.started/run.activity, persisted chat.assistant, chat.user user-turns) including the approve -> continuing activity state — against the real reducer, no faked events.
2. ACTIVITY SPINE: it SHALL render a non-blank live state across every phase (understand/stack/plan/design/working/verify) and in every tier, and SHALL show 'continuing' immediately after a decision/needs-input is answered.
3. PERSISTENCE: a run's transcript + last activity SHALL survive a simulated reopen against the REAL trace store, and GET /conversations SHALL list the run with correct metadata from the REAL ledgers.
4. COMPOSER: the context-aware transitions (idle->start, running->steer, needs_input->answer, stopped/completed->continue) SHALL be asserted against the real state, and continue SHALL resume the same durable plan against the real engine resume path.
5. ENGINE: phase/activity + heartbeat emission SHALL be proven against the REAL drive() path (real orchestrator Observer + broker), including a heartbeat during a long simulated phase.
6. NO test in this feature SHALL substitute a stub/mock/fake for a real code path or type to manufacture a pass.
